en: Fixed `claude plugin uninstall` removing the other of two installed plugins whose ids differ only in case, with its options and secrets, when the one named had no `enabledPlugins` entry at that scope
zh: 修复当指定的 plugin 在该作用域下没有 `enabledPlugins` 条目时，`claude plugin uninstall` 误删两个 id 仅大小写不同的已安装 plugin 中的另一个（连同其选项和密钥）的问题
